name: Amuro Ray
source:
From: Mobile Suit Gundam Char's Counterattack
A Newtype pilot with the Earth Federation Forces' Londo Bell unit. Rank: Lieutenant. He piloted the RX-78 Gundam in the One Year War and took part in numerousbattles. He manifested as a Newtype during the conflict and left behind a field record which became the stuff of legend.
